entities.summary: Lourinhã is a municipality in the District of Lisbon and in the Portuguese Oeste region. The population in 2011 was 25,735, in an area of 147.17 km2. The seat of the municipality is the town of Lourinhã, with a population of 8,800 inhabitants.
